title: Bilateral Log-Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.18974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early

translated_abstract: 序列模型以不同的分辨率表示过去的上下文，包括使用token级别的键和值、固定大小的循环状态，或压缩摘要的层次结构。完整注意力支持强大的关联召回能力，但在训练和预填充阶段需要二次方复杂度的计算，且在推理时需要线性增长的键值缓存。线性注意力和状态空间模型通过固定大小的循环记忆降低了这些成本，但这种压缩可能限制召回能力。对数线性注意力提供了一个折中方案，通过维护对数数量的状态矩阵。然而，其层次结构偏向于在当前查询附近提供更细的分辨率，而将较早的上下文压缩为更粗略的摘要。为了补充这种分辨率分配方式，我们引入了双边对数线性注意力，它将现有的层次结构与第二个锚定在序列起点的层次结构相配对。通过结合两个分支的读取，这两个分支为序列早期和近期的上下文都提供了更精细的访问能力。
tldr: 提出双边对数线性注意力，通过将锚定于当前查询和序列起点的两个互补状态层次结构相结合，同时为序列早期和近期上下文提供更精细的访问，在计算效率与召回能力之间取得更好平衡。
en_tdlr: Introduces bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs two complementary state hierarchies—one anchored at the current query and one at the sequence origin—to enable finer-grained access to both early and recent context, balancing efficiency and recall.
